How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?

Standard shipping usually takes 1-3 business days for us to fulfill your order, plus another 4-8 business days for shipping. So, you can expect your order to arrive within 5-11 business days total. Most orders arrive on the quicker side, but we provide this full range just to be safe. 😊

You can find all the details on our shipping information page if you’d like to read more!

turns.replyText:
What's your return and refund policy?

Our return and refund policy is designed to be as easy as possible:

Most unused, non-defective items can be returned for a full refund within 90 days of purchase, as long as they're in original packaging.
Personalized or custom items, and orders shipped to Canada, aren't eligible for return.
The cost of return shipping will be deducted from your refund.
We don't offer direct exchanges, but you can return an item and place a new order if needed.

You can find all the details and start a return on our return policy page. Let me know if you have any other questions!
